invariants.rationale: The method always returns a List via collect; result should never be null.
hoodieRecords is a method parameter and is passed to other methods; likely not null at return.
The result list is filtered to include only records with isCurrentLocationKnown == false.
The result is a filtered subset of the input; it cannot have more elements than the input.
The result is a filtered sublist of hoodieRecords; all elements of result come from hoodieRecords.
